Активен режим, выбранный выше. FSR 4 мож: The mode selected above is active. FSR 4 can be selected again.
FSR 4.1.1 в режиме INT8: модель из DLL A: FSR 4.1.1 in INT8 mode: the model from the AMD 4.1.1 DLL, reproduced in Vulkan (output matches the DLL). One model for Native..Performance and a separate one for Ultra Performance. Assets: tools/fsr4cap/build_assets.sh (needs the DLLs and Proton).
FSR 4 в режиме INT8 (модель v07 из исход: FSR 4 in INT8 mode (model v07 from the AMD FidelityFX SDK source). Higher quality than FSR 3.1, but a heavier pass. Changing the preset rebuilds the model (short pause). Assets: tools/fetch_fsr4_assets.sh.
Проверка при гостинге: сеть FSR 4 нормир: Try these if you see ghosting: the FSR 4 network normalizes color by exposure and uses it to decide when to discard previous frames. Changes apply immediately, no restart.
TAA сглаживает сцену в разрешении вывода: TAA anti-aliases the scene at output resolution, without an FSR model or upscaling. The saved FSR preset is restored when FSR is selected.
При выводе не 1080p вся игра рисуется в: When output is not 1080p, the whole game renders at the preset resolution (patched at launch): fastest on Steam Deck and weak GPUs. Changing the preset or output resolution needs a restart. The "Resolution change on the fly" option below allows changes without a restart (post-processing then stays at 1080p, slower).
BB_RENDER_RES фиксирует размер сцены при: BB_RENDER_RES fixes the scene size at launch. Remove this explicit variable to change resolution and presets without restarting the game.
Native AA: FSR works as anti-aliasing. Other presets lower the scene render resolution relative to the output. The UI is drawn at output resolution. The preset applies from the next frame without restarting the game.
До 1 — резкость самого апскейлера (RCAS): Up to 1: the upscaler's own sharpening (RCAS). Above 1 an extra RCAS pass is added. Ctrl+click the slider to enter an exact value.
Каждый кадр сцена сдвигается на долю пик: Each frame the scene shifts by a fraction of a pixel, and the upscaler gathers more detail from several frames. Without it you only get anti-aliasing from history.
Помечает прозрачные эффекты (частицы, ды: Marks transparent effects (particles, haze) so the upscaler relies less on previous frames. Less trailing behind effects, but shimmering returns under them.
Точные векторы для анимированных объекто: Exact vectors for animated objects: clothing and weapons break up less in motion. The static scene gets no extra pass. Takes effect after restarting the game.
Красный/зелёный: движение по горизонтали: Red/green: horizontal/vertical motion (8 pixels = full brightness). Blue: the pixel got an exact object vector, not just camera motion. A moving object with no blue and no red/green is treated as static by the upscaler, hence the trail.
Размер готового кадра и интерфейса. Прес: Size of the final frame and UI. The preset sets the scene size relative to the output: 4K Performance = 1920x1080. Takes effect after restarting the game.
Размер готового кадра и интерфейса меняе: Size of the final frame and UI changes at the next frame boundary. The preset sets the scene size relative to the output: 4K Performance = 1920x1080. Changing size resets FSR history and may cause a short pause.
Включена: разрешение вывода и пресет мен: On: output resolution and preset change without a restart, but the game's post-processing stays at 1080p, noticeably slower on Steam Deck and older GPUs. Off: everything renders at the preset resolution, changes need a restart. Auto enables it on powerful discrete GPUs. Takes effect after restarting the game.
Эффекты включаются и выключаются патчами: Effects are toggled by game patches at launch (patches/Bloodborne.xml). Motion blur and dynamic light shadows put a noticeable load on the GPU.
Свободная камера: удерживайте Cross и на: Free camera: hold Cross and press L3 (keyboard: Space + Z). Debug menu: left touchpad / Tab. Needs DbgFont14h.ccm and DbgFont14h.tpf in dvdroot_ps4/font from Nexus mod #253. Right touchpad: Backspace.
Изменения применятся после перезапуска и: Changes apply after restarting the game
